scope: bounded validation engineering cost for the two largest remaining cells, using frozen V4 ranking and V6 accounting

selection.exclusion: Union of historical 64, 48, 34 and 8 cohorts = 152 distinct keys, only intersection is 2 in the first two cohorts
selection.order: Per eligible cell, ascending raw SHA-256 of the ASCII prefix including terminating NUL followed by decoded 32 key-hash bytes, then ascending original ordinal. Deliver combined subset sorted by original ordinal.
selection.allowed_inputs: Bound structural roster, frozen cells and historical excluded identities only. Full independent sort and seal before paired source extraction.
selection.on_mismatch: Stop on changed source, shortfall or identity mismatch. No replacement or redistribution.

measurement.sources: Seven aligned source byte streams; independent V4 ranker, precise four arms and V6 checkpoint

work_checks.both_cells: Complete eligible pool count and SHA; min(eligible_neighbors,500) selected in exact score and tie order. Source comparison, causal catalog, per-selected membership sizes, exact vote/metric/delta bits, EOF and full checkpoint chain.
work_checks.1101/n5/v5: 1,000–4,999 eligible, 500 selected. Actual membership rows at most vote_memberships_upper. Validate cutoff ties and preserve equal-upper cases as valid.
work_checks.0010/n3/v2: 100–499 eligible, all selected. Actual membership rows equal vote_memberships_upper. No 500th-neighbor boundary.

measurement.timing: Per-cell maximum of verification plus append excluding commit and same-row direct budget publication, plus raw enclosing and partitioned times. Setup, tail, all commits and budget shown separately.
measurement.publish_when: Two freshly reconstructed ledgers identical frame by frame; source and method pins reverified; externally observed normal exit and independent post-exit audit.
